remarks: Renovated from top to bottom, this stunning one bedroom condo is ideally located in the heart of Downtown Stamford, offering effortless access to everything the city has to offer. Set within a beautifully updated prewar building, the residence blends classic architectural character with modern luxury. Rich hardwood floors and refined trim work enhance the home's timeless appeal throughout. The European inspired kitchen features oversized quartz countertops, a breakfast bar, high end finishes, refrigerator and dishwasher with multiple drawers, and a wine chiller, perfect for entertaining before stepping out to nearby restaurants, theaters, or waterfront events. The sleek bathroom offers a walk-in shower wrapped in porcelain tile. A sun filled living room boasts oversized windows, custom built-in cabinetry for the TV, in unit washing machine, and a thoughtfully designed workspace with a built-in standing desk, ideal for today's flexible lifestyle. The spacious bedroom includes a custom built in media center, automated window shades and a walk-in closet. Enjoy a truly walkable lifestyle just moments from award winning dining, farmers market, street fairs, theaters, parks, and MetroNorth for an easy NYC commute. Additional features include dedicated storage, with heat and hot water included in the monthly fees. An added bonus for investment-savvy buyers: no rental restrictions, making this an exceptional opportunity in one of Downtown Stamford's most desirable locations.
